================================================================================
SYNTHETIC DEMO NOTICE C — MUNICIPAL DRINKING WATER PRECAUTIONARY BOIL ADVISORY
================================================================================
MUNICIPAL CORPORATION PUBLIC HEALTH & WATER SUPPLY WING
Central Municipal Administrative Offices, Ward 7 Engineering Station

Notice Bulletin No: MC-PH-WATER/2026/WARD7-ADVISORY
Issued Date: 19 October 2026

PUBLIC HEALTH ADVISORY: MANDATORY WATER BOIL DIRECTIVE FOR RIVERSIDE SECTOR (WARD 7)

1. REASON FOR ADVISORY:
Due to an unexpected rupture in the 450mm primary water transmission main along Riverside Boulevard and ongoing emergency pipeline replacement works, a temporary drop in line pressure occurred. As a mandatory precautionary protocol under municipal health standards, this boil advisory is issued immediately for all households, commercial establishments, and schools in Ward 7.

2. MANDATORY SAFETY INSTRUCTIONS:
- VIGOROUSLY BOIL ALL TAP WATER for at least 3 FULL MINUTES before using it for drinking, food preparation, making ice, brushing teeth, washing dishes, or preparing baby formula.
- Allow the water to cool in clean, covered containers before consumption.
- If boiling is not feasible, use bottled water or certified disinfected water.
- Infant children, elderly citizens, and immunocompromised individuals should strictly use bottled water.

3. INTENTIONALLY UNSTATED DETAILS (TESTING ZERO-HALLUCINATION DEFENSE):
- There is NO application fee or monetary cost applicable.
- There are NO application forms, permits, or registration procedures required.
- There are NO documents or certificates needed from residents.
- There is NO fixed closing deadline: the advisory will remain in effect until bacteriological testing confirms the water meets safety parameters. Subsequent lifting notification will be published separately.

4. EMERGENCY HELPLINE:
Municipal Water Works 24/7 Control Desk: 011-5550-1234
Public Health Officer Hotline: 011-5550-5678
